## Description

**What**: Update AGENTS.md, CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md, and the visual-evaluator SKILL.md docs to reflect the new VLM evaluator agent, skill, and sprint integration.

**Why**: New agents, skills, and config keys require reference documentation so future sessions know they exist.

**Scope**:
- IN: plugins/dso/docs/AGENTS.md — add visual-evaluator agent entry
- IN: plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md — add visual_evaluator.* config keys
- IN: plugins/dso/skills/visual-evaluator/ — any skill-local docs updates
- OUT: New documentation files; CLAUDE.md (use CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report if needed)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, AGENTS.md includes an entry for dso:visual-evaluator agent with description, model, and invocation context
  <- Satisfies: sc-1 (documentation evidence)
- When this story is complete, CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md includes all visual_evaluator.* config keys (iteration_cap, iteration_threshold, post_batch_token_budget, dimension_weights, cache_max_entries)
  <- Satisfies: sc-2 (configuration evidence)
- When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- Apply /Users/joeoakhart/.claude/plugins/cache/digital-service-orchestra/dso-dev/1.17.65/skills/shared/prompts/doc-router.md gates before writing. CLAUDE.md edits require a CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report — do not edit CLAUDE.md directly. If .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md exists, follow it for formatting.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue. Escalate only when genuinely blocked. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
